mapper.select: SELECT s."id" AS supervisor_id, s."groupName" AS supervisor_group, st."id" AS student_id, st."username" AS student_username, st."LTHeartRate" AS student_LTHeartRate, st."CURRENT DATE" AS student_currentDate FROM "supervisors" s JOIN "student" st ON s."groupName" = st."groupName" WHERE s."groupName" = #{groupName}
